r: Reload command allows you to reload running cache service. In other words, configuration will be cleared and pushed again.

Environment variables have lower priority than command line options but higher than configuration file.

DBUS_NAME
DBUS name that dnsconfd should use, default com.redhat.dnsconfd
LOG_LEVEL
Log level of dnsconfd, default INFO
CONFIG_FILE
Path where config file is located, default /etc/dnsconfd.conf
Please for reporting bugs use Github repository https://github.com/InfrastructureServices/dnsconfd

dnsconfd(8) Dnsconfd daemon dnsconfd-status(8) Check status of dnsconfd dnsconfd-config(8) Change configuration of host dnsconfd-update(8) Change Dnsconfd configuration dnsconfd.conf(5) Dnsconfd configuration file
